views.markdown:
**One circular design. Three live indicators.**

DuoBar brings battery percentage, Wi‑Fi strength, and cellular signal together in a clean, compact status-bar icon for iOS 16.

views.text: Design preview · illustrative values, not an on-device screenshot

views.markdown:
- Battery percentage with an open circular charge ring
- Wi‑Fi indicator in the center and four cellular dots
- Light and dark status-bar appearances
- Special colors for low battery, charging, and Low Power Mode
- **Settings → DuoBar → Enable DuoBar** to turn it on or restore the original icons
- Control Center battery percentage and rotation-lock overlap fixes
- Custom Settings icon, organized options, and direct RBx9 Repo / Sileo links
- Adjustable DuoBar Size slider from **70% to 140%** with live updates and Reset Size to 100%
- **New v0.2.6:** Transparent Settings icon and Report a Bug / Help Test Other iOS Versions email shortcuts
- Updated to the v0.2.6 codebase, including the Personal Hotspot chain-link inside the ring and Control Center layout fixes

**iOS 16.x · standard Rootless / Dopamine only** (`iphoneos-arm64`, installation at `/var/jb`). Requires Rootless tweak injection and PreferenceLoader. **Not compatible with RootHide**; choose DuoBar (RootHide) for that jailbreak.

The Rootless package **compiled and passed architecture, `/var/jb` layout, package-metadata and Settings icon checks**. It has **not yet been confirmed on a Rootless iPhone**. Please report whether the status-bar display, size slider and Control Center work correctly. Do not install alongside DuoBar (RootHide).
